partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: GOF activity-phosphorylation suppression consensus
results.hypothesis: A directly bound GOF driver is more credibly suppressed when both its activity and phosphorylation are decreased.
results.body: drug directly binds GOF Gene2Phenotype driver and decreases both activity and phosphorylation
results.mechanism_rationale: Two signed molecular aspects agree on suppression of the causal GOF protein, although both are CTD-derived.
results.trapi_notes: The binding, qualified activity and phosphorylation effects, and variant-qualified disease path are TRAPI-expressible; provenance and disease constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(driver:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[activity:AFFECTS]->(driver)
MATCH (subject)-[phosphorylation:AFFECTS]->(driver)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE activity.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND activity.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity'
  AND activity.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND phosphorylation.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND phosphorylation.object_aspect_qualifier = 'phosphorylation'
  AND phosphorylation.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND activity <> phosphorylation
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.body: R343 with increased rather than decreased driver phosphorylation
results.mechanism_rationale: The two molecular aspects point in different directions.
